name: 道の駅 しんよしとみ
desc: 福岡県上毛町の国道10号沿いにある道の駅「しんよしとみ」。最大の特徴は、国の史跡「大ノ瀬官衙（おおのせかんが）遺跡」に隣接していること。広大な芝生広場で歴史と自然を感じながらリフレッシュできます。特産品は、地元農家が育てる新鮮な朝採れ野菜や、名産のレモン、いちじく、柚子を使った加工品など。手作りの惣菜やスイーツも人気で、歴史ロマンと豊かな食を同時に満喫できる魅力的なスポットです。
descEn: Located along Route 10 in Koge Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Shinyoshitomi" is uniquely situated right next to the Oonose Kanga Ruins, a designated national historic site. Visitors can relax and refresh in the vast lawn area while experiencing a blend of history and nature. Its local specialties include freshly harvested vegetables grown by local farmers, as well as products made from the town's famous lemons, figs, and yuzu. With popular handmade deli items and sweets also available, it is an attractive spot where you can fully enjoy both historical romance and rich local food.
